newsitem.title: GERMANY: BOE's George says UK economy "in very good shape".
newsitem.headline: BOE's George says UK economy "in very good shape".

text.p: Bank of England governor Eddie George said on Tuesday that he thought the British economy was in very good shape.
Asked for a comment on the state of the British economy, George said: "It is in very good shape," but he declined to say whether this had any interest rate implications.
George went on to play down the stern tone of the European Monetary Institute's annual report, released today.

"If you look at the reports going back over the past few years we have always been stern. We're stern chaps," said George, referring to the tone the EMI has taken to fiscal convergence in the run-up to currency union.
George was speaking after the regular meeting of the European Monetary Institute (EMI) council in Frankfurt.
